name: HIRE Ai
summary: Pilot recruitment and assessment software with proctored online tests, computer-vision proctoring and an AI-scored Voice English test modelled on the ICAO scale.
paragraphs: Pilot recruitment and assessment software with proctored online tests, computer-vision proctoring and an AI-scored Voice English test modelled on the ICAO scale.
whyItMatters: Every applicant sits the same proctored tests, and the recruiter still makes the call, which makes screening easier to defend.
